title: 文本加密
problem_statement_md:
假设正在编写一个文本加密程序。
它接受多个单词并输出一个组合字符串，其中每个单词用美元符号`$`隔开。

例如，对于 "hello"、"how"、"are"、"you"这些词，输出应该是 `$hello$how$are$you$`。

给定的代码声明了一个**Add**类，它的构造函数需要一个Rest参数，从而接收任意数量的单词。
通过在该类中添加一个**print**()方法来完成该功能，该方法应该按要求输出内容。
problem_statement_en_md:
[s0l0!-header][h1]Words[/h1][/s0l0!-header] 

You are making a text encryptor. It should take multiple words and output a combined version, where each word is separated by a dollar sign $. 
For example, for the words "[b]hello[/b]", "[b]how[/b]", "[b]are[/b]", "[b]you[/b]", the output should be "[b]$hello$how$are$you$[/b]".
The given code declares a class named [b]Add[/b], with a constructor that takes one rest parameter.
Complete the code by adding a [b]print[/b]() method to the class, which should generate the requested output.
[note]Note, that the dollar sign is placed at the beginning and at the end of the output.[/note]
hint_md: 注意，美元符号`$`在输出的开头和结尾处及单词之间。
